# Anna Pogrebniak

> Fractional growth marketer for B2B SaaS, based in Ghent, Belgium and working across Europe. Eleven years of experience, 23 brands, EUR 3M in ad spend managed. Builds the marketing engine, runs the ads, and gets companies found in AI search. Founder of Awesome Marketers, a 2,000-member marketing community in Finland.

Anna works with European B2B SaaS companies as a fractional (part-time, senior) marketer, typically as the first or only marketing hire. She was the first marketing hire at three companies. She is strongest where marketing strategy and hands-on execution have to live in the same person, and where the sales cycle is long and enterprise-shaped.

## Services

- **Fractional growth**: the whole marketing function in one person. Growth strategy and ICP, demand generation, HubSpot and marketing operations, content and SEO, LinkedIn thought leadership, pipeline reporting.
- **Fractional ads**: paid acquisition on LinkedIn, Meta and Google. Full-funnel ad strategy, multi-market funnels, retargeting and light ABM, ad concepts, copy and creative. Ad budgets from EUR 3k to EUR 50k per month, currently around EUR 90k a month live across eight ad accounts.
- **Fractional AEO**: answer engine optimisation. AI visibility audits, prompt and mention tracking, comparison and alternatives pages, schema and structured data, and content that LLMs actually cite.

## Selected results

- EUR 288k new ARR from ads in twelve months at 4.7:1 LTV:CAC, across five European markets on a EUR 250k yearly budget, for an enterprise sales-led platform with a six-month-plus sales cycle.
- 2.8x more visibility in Google's AI Overviews and other generative surfaces within a month of starting AEO work, measured across the whole site rather than one market.
- 49% of open pipeline already touched by ads before sales opened a conversation, via account-targeted paid LinkedIn.
- 50% of a EUR 1M open pipeline ad-influenced as a solo marketer, via paid LinkedIn and thought leadership content.
- 200 leads at EUR 20 CPL on a EUR 4k one-month budget for a new product launch. 5% lead-to-meeting blended, 15% on LinkedIn.
- Cost per MQL cut by 40% in three months after taking over an existing ad account at a PLG brand mid-repositioning.
- 150 ICP leads from a single webinar on a EUR 2.5k tools and ads budget, for a scale-up with no marketing investment for three years.
- A EUR 14.5k deal closed after a prospect attended three thought-leadership webinars, then returned for a fourth as a customer.

## Brands worked with

In-house: Lumoa (feedback analytics, Finland), Netigate (survey tech, Sweden), AddSearch (site search, Finland).
Agency-side: QPR Software (business intelligence, Finland), Shared Contacts for Gmail (France), AdvanceB2B (B2B SaaS agency, Finland), AIContentfy (AI content platform).
Fractional: Hello Customer (voice of customer platform, Belgium), Trustmary (Finland), Remotion (LinkedIn Ads agency), Tangently (Finland), Inklusiiv (Finland), Euro Car Wash.
Freelance SEO and link building: Droppe (Finland), Glassix.

## Skills

Marketing and growth strategy, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, AEO and AI search visibility, demand generation, email nurture, marketing automation, HubSpot, marketing operations, ABM, lead scoring, content strategy, webinars, landing pages, custom reporting dashboards, Claude and agentic AI.

## Tooling

Anna builds her own client reporting dashboards with Claude: budget pacing, per-creative performance and status tracking, refreshed daily across eight live ad accounts and three currencies.

- **Mentoring**: free one-to-one sessions with marketers and founders on GrowthMentor. 20+ sessions so far, rated five stars.
